topStory.title: Musk says SpaceX has closed $40 billion in debt to buy AI chips
topStory.snippet: Musk said the mostly callable debt will pay for GPUs due in the first half of 2027; Bloomberg reported pricing talks were still ongoing.

Starlink service in Ukraine back to normal after a weeklong disruption

summary: 8 stories (last 7 days). Most active frontier: xAI & Grok. Top story: Musk says SpaceX has closed $40 billion in debt to buy AI chips.

bullets: Elon Musk said SpaceX has closed $40 billion in debt to buy AI chips arriving in 2027, though Bloomberg reported pricing talks were still under way.
SpaceX and Tesla have each formed special board committees of independent directors to review a possible merger; no terms have been agreed.
Musk said Starship Flight 15, which is set to attempt the first tower catch of the ship itself, could fly within about four to six weeks of mid-October.
Grok released the first seven minutes of its AI-generated 'Odyssey' series, and Starlink service in Ukraine is back to normal after a weeklong disruption.
